question: In a certain code language, IMPORT is written as GKRQPR. how will EXPEND be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f390eb1aa5eef27c267010a8106c7b83cfbeaa1b6c945402f538a1e70a0d41b.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**First two letters of given word is subtracted -2.**

**Next two letters of given word is added +2 and it is repeated.**
